40 Kid-Friendly Snack Recipes

October 13, 2026October 13, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 7:53
Instaread

Find easy kid-friendly snack recipes for lunchboxes, after school, birthday parties, and summer, with plenty of healthy and fun treats to try!

40 Kids Snack Recipes

Finding snacks that kids will actually get excited about doesn’t have to mean making something complicated! This collection of kid-friendly snack recipes is packed with easy, fun ideas for just about any occasion. You’ll find everything from quick lunchbox and after-school snacks to colorful treats that are perfect for birthday parties, playdates, and summer afternoons.

There’s a little bit of everything here, too! Some of these recipes are made with wholesome ingredients like fresh fruit, yogurt, and oats, while others are simply fun treats meant to put a smile on their faces. Whether you need something healthy to keep hungry kids going between meals or a special snack to make an ordinary day more fun, there are plenty of ideas to choose from.

Tap a recipe name or photo to open the full ingredient list and instructions.

Celery Bug Snacks – Turn simple ingredients like celery, peanut butter, and fresh fruit into cute little critters! These easy, healthy snacks are fun for kids to make and perfect for parties, lunchboxes, or after-school snacking.

Honey Nut Cheerio Balls – These easy Honey Nut Cheerio Balls put a fun cereal twist on classic popcorn balls! Sweet, crunchy, and kid-friendly, they’re perfect for lunchboxes, after-school snacks, or parties.

Gluten Free Granola – This crunchy gluten-free granola is packed with wholesome superfoods for a delicious and satisfying snack! Enjoy it by the handful, with milk, or sprinkled over yogurt.

Homemade Cosmic Brownies – These homemade Cosmic Brownies are thick, chewy, and topped with rich chocolate ganache and colorful rainbow chips for a fun copycat of the classic lunchbox treat!

Mini Heart-Shaped Pizzas – These mini heart-shaped pizzas are made with just four simple ingredients for a fun and easy snack kids will love!

Brownie Popsicles – These adorable Brownie Pops turn fudgy brownies into a fun treat on a stick! Dip them in chocolate and decorate with your favorite toppings for parties, holidays, or a special snack.

Pencil Treat Bags – These Pencil Treat Bags are a cute and easy snack idea for back-to-school or classroom parties! Layers of colorful treats are arranged to look just like a pencil.

Berry Frozen Yogurt Bites – These easy 3-ingredient frozen yogurt bites are made with real fruit for a refreshing, kid-friendly snack that’s perfect for hot summer days.

Homemade Fruit Leather – These easy homemade fruit roll-ups are made with just two ingredients and real fruit for a naturally sweet, kid-friendly snack.

Classic No Bake Cookies – These classic no-bake cookies are rich, chocolatey, and packed with chewy oats and peanut butter. Best of all, there’s no oven required!

Chewy M&M Cookie Bars – These M&M Cookie Bars have crisp edges, soft and chewy centers, and plenty of colorful chocolate candies in every bite.

Goldfish Crackers – These homemade Goldfish Crackers are crispy, crunchy, and packed with cheesy flavor, with just four simple ingredients.

Strawberry Ladybugs – These chocolate strawberry ladybugs turn fresh fruit into a cute and healthy snack that’s fun for kids to make and eat!

Brown Butter Rice Krispie Treats – These Brown Butter Rice Krispie Treats put a delicious twist on the childhood classic, with rich, nutty caramel flavor and just a hint of salt.

S’Mores Puppy Chow – This S’mores Puppy Chow combines chocolate, marshmallow, and graham cracker flavors in an easy, crunchy snack that tastes like the campfire classic.

Chocolate Hummus – This easy Chocolate Hummus is a sweet and creamy snack that kids and grown-ups will love, and it’s ready in less than 10 minutes.

Peanut Butter Granola Bars – These soft-baked peanut butter granola bars are made with peanut butter and honey for a satisfying, energy-packed snack kids will love. Plus, you only need five simple ingredients!

Instant Pot Popcorn – Make buttery, fluffy popcorn right in your Instant Pot! This quick and easy method makes perfectly popped popcorn for movie nights or snacking.

Homemade Strawberry Gummy Bears – These homemade strawberry gummies are made with real fruit and no refined sugar for a fun, kid-friendly alternative to store-bought fruit snacks.

Rainbow Crackers – These colorful Rainbow Graham Crackers are a fun and easy snack for kids, and (and they also make an adorable St. Patrick’s Day treat!)

Under the Sea Snack – These Under the Sea Snacks are wholesome, easy to make, and almost too cute to eat! They’re perfect for an ocean-themed party or making everyday snack time a little more fun.

Healthy Homemade Green Gummy Snacks – These healthy homemade green gummies are packed with real fruit and veggies for a fun, kid-friendly snack you can feel good about serving anytime.

3-Ingredient Granola Bites – Tasty little bites of granola and chocolate, made with just 3 simple ingredients. Perfect for packing in a school lunchbox!

Gatorade Slushy – These refreshing Gatorade Slushies are cool, icy, and easy to make for a fun drink that helps replenish electrolytes on hot summer days.

Homemade Gummy Bears – These homemade gummy bears are sweet, chewy, and easy to make with just three simple ingredients, including a box of Jello.

Homemade Oatmeal Creme Pies – These homemade Oatmeal Cream Pies feature two soft and chewy oatmeal cookies filled with sweet cream for a delicious copycat of the nostalgic Little Debbie favorite!

Donut Sugar Cookies – These fun Donut Cookies are soft sugar cookies decorated to look just like chocolate sprinkle donuts, making them a cute treat for kids and grown-ups alike.

Candy Sushi – This fun Candy Sushi is made with chewy gummy candy and Rice Krispie treats for an easy, adorable snack that kids will love making and eating!

Grape Gummy Bears – These Grape Juice Gummy Bears are made with real fruit juice for a fun, easy homemade alternative to store-bought gummy candy.

Pop It Chocolate – These Chocolate Pop It Candy Bars turn the viral toy into a fun candy-making activity! They’re easy for kids to make and just as much fun to eat.

LEGO Rice Krispie Treats – These colorful frosted rice krispie treats look just like a LEGO block. They are a fun and easy recipe to make with the kids and a perfect treat for any LEGO fan!

Homemade Nutter Butters – These Homemade Nutter Butter Cookies feature soft peanut butter cookies sandwiched with a creamy peanut butter filling for a delicious homemade twist on the classic!

Coconut Clusters – These crunchy Coconut Clusters are naturally sweet, packed with fiber and protein, and take just minutes to make for an easy lunchbox or anytime snack.

Apple Pie Spiced Pretzels – These Apple Pie Spiced Pretzels are sweet, salty, and crunchy with plenty of warm fall flavor! They’re perfect for lunchboxes, snacking, or serving with your favorite sweet dips.

Cake Batter Popcorn – This Cake Batter Popcorn combines fluffy popcorn with a sweet vanilla marshmallow coating and colorful sprinkles for a fun, festive treat kids will love.

Chocolate Blueberry Clusters – These Blueberry Pistachio Clusters combine juicy blueberries, rich chocolate, and crunchy pistachios for an easy bite-sized treat that’s perfect for lunchboxes, party platters, or snacking!

Fruity Pebbles Cupcakes – These festive cupcakes are easy cake mix batter filled with colorful cereal and topped with even more Fruity Pebbles for a fun, kid-friendly treat.

Cute and Easy LEGO Brownies – Chewy fudge brownies decorated with frosting and candy to look like building blocks!

Pumpkin Blueberry Muffins – These fluffy Pumpkin Blueberry Muffins are filled with juicy blueberries and warm pumpkin spice for a delicious fall breakfast, snack, or sweet treat.

Easy Apple Bread – This moist Apple Bread is packed with tender apple chunks, warm spices, and crunchy pecans for a delicious fall breakfast, snack, or dessert.
